messages.author: aishen
messages.body:
Hi,
Everything is going much better, so I decided to run tutorial in jupyter
notebook, so far no real problem, amber tutorials are well done
(thanks), when I run
!$AMBERHOME/bin/ambpdb -p TC5b.prmtop -c min1.ncrst > min1.pdb
the answer is : /bin/bash: /bin/ambpdb: Aucun fichier ou dossier de ce type
but the files are done ! Is it normal ?
Every command has this kind of answer so at the beginning I thaught I
did something wrong but I realised files were done !
I guess this is a jupyter answer ?
regards
Henri

messages.author: Bill Ross
messages.body:
It sounds like you don't have the amber environment. Look into sourcing
amber.sh to get that into the notebook; I haven't used one yet.
Bill

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Sep 07, 2020, aishen wrote:
>
>
>
>!$AMBERHOME/bin/ambpdb -p TC5b.prmtop -c min1.ncrst > min1.pdb
>
>the answer is : /bin/bash: /bin/ambpdb: Aucun fichier ou dossier de ce type
This looks like $AMBERHOME is not being picked up inside the Jupyter notebook.
I'm not sure what the causes of this (or the solution) might be.  As a test,
just manually expand out $AMBERHOME to its correct value inside your notebook.
>Every command has this kind of answer so at the beginning I thaught I
>did something wrong but I realised files were done !
Are you sure the files weren't already there from some previous work?
....dac
